# DEPRECATED: This file is no longer the source of truth for dependencies.
#
# The project has migrated to uv for dependency management:
#   - Source: pyproject.toml
#   - Lock file: uv.lock (cross-platform, multi-arch, Python 3.12+ and 3.13+)
#   - Pip fallback: requirements.lock (auto-generated from uv.lock)
#
# For uv-based installs (recommended):
#   uv sync --frozen
#
# For pip-based installs:
#   pip install -r requirements.lock
#
# To regenerate requirements.lock:
#   uv export --format requirements-txt --no-editable --no-emit-project --quiet > requirements.lock
